purpose: Owner-source BE handoff plus the approved All-tab aggregate. Source routes remain diagnostic/owner reads; FE must use the aggregate for All and must not merge owner pages.

status_aliases.WAITING_APPROVAL: SCANNING plus ready_for_post=true; not a canonical status

P12_INBOUND_LIST.date_semantics: inclusive local start, exclusive start of the next local date

P12_OUTBOUND_LIST.date_semantics: inclusive local start, exclusive start of the next local date

P09_WARRANTY_LIST.pagination: KEYSET by default; OFFSET only with page; page+cursor rejected

aggregate.total: meta.total counts the complete authorized filtered selected scope before cursor pagination
aggregate.snapshot: single response snapshot with cursor upper bound; not frozen across requests

count_evidence.filtered_total: Same owner meta.total before pagination, never data.length. May be cached on P12.
count_evidence.unfiltered_authorized_total: Equals meta.total only for an unfiltered request to this authorized endpoint; null otherwise. This is not an additional query or a total across sources.
count_evidence.source_empty: Boolean only for an unfiltered request; null for filtered/unknown criteria. false/0 readiness flags count as filters.
count_evidence.snapshot: No shared cross-request snapshot. P12 keeps its existing read-cache freshness; P09 snapshot applies to one read only. Do not label this a new live observation.

state_rules.S02: All is empty only after a successful unfiltered aggregate response with meta.total=0 and empty data. A source tab may describe only that source.
state_rules.S03: A successful filtered aggregate response with total=0 and empty data is no-results, never warehouse-empty.
state_rules.page_empty_with_positive_total: Concurrent change or cursor boundary; not S02/S03. Restart at cursor=start when required by the cursor policy.
state_rules.denied_or_failed_source: 401/403/5xx, timeout, malformed JSON, missing meta.total, wrong scope, missing required source or stale caller response are not empty or zero.
state_rules.partial: The aggregate fails closed. Never sum a failed source as zero or merge page-sized owner arrays as a global page/total.

identity.id: Owner UUID only; keep source/type in the FE key. Never use displayed doc_no/case number as an ID.
identity.request_id: HTTP X-Request-ID / meta.request_id is trace correlation only.
identity.scope: P16 sends the verified current warehouse UUID on each list. P12 native permission/warehouse middleware and P09 persisted ownership remain authoritative. P12 itself is not made active-session-only by this change.
identity.cache: FE cache keys must include actor, auth session, verified warehouse, source, filters, sort and page/cursor. Discard late responses after context changes. Never use a prior actor response or old cursor after login.
identity.pii: Keep native owner PII masking and nulls. Do not enrich the list from a less restricted endpoint.

errors.403: Respect owner error.code; do not turn proxy HTML into a business permission diagnosis.
errors.409: Scope/context conflict; do not switch warehouse automatically.
errors.5xx_timeout_malformed: Load/partial error; preserve evidence and do not synthesize data or success.

P04.policy: Use verified inbound creation capability and explicit owner handoff.

P05.policy: Source-linked and standalone are not interchangeable; no replacement outbound creation from an empty list.

P09.policy: Use warranty owner capability; list read permission is not create permission.

prototype: Keep prototype fixtures/adapters separate. Production adapter must never import fixtures as fallback.

live_smoke.note: The aggregate is the only All-tab source. The four-request owner collection is retained for auth/source smoke and diagnosis, not FE page merging; aggregate smoke is a separate GET.
required_evidence: aggregate full-set total and every source facet
FE response/caller isolation and CTA owner proof
forbidden: migration or seeding on live to manufacture evidence
